Callout.Name: Dine and Dash
Callout.Message: Group left a restaurant without paying.
Callout.Advisory: Three people, staff have the description.

Script.Line: The food was cold when it came. That is why we stopped paying.
We would have paid. We were going to pay.
I have got money on me. Look, I have got money on me.

Lines.Approach: Three of them, ate and walked out. Staff want it dealt with and they have the bill ready.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
